label: Слишком
description: A 10-sentence usage card for слишком (too, excessively).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Excess with an adjective. 'Слишком' means too or excessively, marking 'горький' as beyond the acceptable level. It precedes the adjective to signal an unwanted excess.
Strategic focus: Excess with an adverb. 'Слишком' scales 'быстро' to mean too fast. It precedes the manner adverb to mark the speed as more than is comfortable.
Strategic focus: Excess of quantity. 'Слишком' combines with 'много' to mean too many. It precedes the quantity word to flag an amount past what is wanted.
Strategic focus: Excess as a problem. 'Слишком' marks 'тяжёлая' as too heavy to manage. The adverb implies a negative consequence beyond the limit.
Strategic focus: Too plus a result clause. 'Слишком' before 'устал' pairs with 'чтобы' to mean too tired to go. This frame expresses excess that blocks an action.
Strategic focus: Excess in a warning. 'Слишком много' before 'сладкого' means too much sweet food. The adverb marks the amount as harmful when exceeded.
Strategic focus: Excess against a standard. 'Слишком' lifts 'дорогое' past the affordable point, meaning too expensive. It precedes the adjective to mark the overshoot.
Strategic focus: Excessive degree of a verb. 'Слишком много' scales 'работаешь' to mean work too much. The pair marks the amount of activity as excessive.
Strategic focus: Excess in an impersonal state. 'Слишком' intensifies the predicative 'шумно' to mean too noisy. It precedes the state word in the impersonal frame.
Strategic focus: Excess relative to ability. 'Слишком' marks 'сложно' as too difficult for a beginner. The adverb signals the difficulty exceeds what the person can handle.
